description: Standing query, zero results expected: no image push to ECR in the last three days by anything but the build role

params.query: SELECT dt, regexp_replace(actor.user.name, '^arn:aws:sts::\d+:assumed-role/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') AS actor, api.operation AS operation, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND api.service.name = 'ecr.amazonaws.com' AND api.operation IN ('PutImage','InitiateLayerUpload','UploadLayerPart','CompleteLayerUpload') AND status = 'Success' AND NOT regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/fedramp-20x-ksi-github-build/') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: ECR only: Artifact Registry pushes are in Cloud Audit Logs, which are not in the corpus.
